highlights: CJEU C-399/24 (16 Oct 2025): a lightning strike + mandatory safety inspection on a preceding flight MAY qualify as 'extraordinary circumstances' under Art. 5(3), but only if the airline proves all reasonable measures were taken.

General Court T-656/24 (4 Mar 2026): a carrier's own discretionary operational decision (e.g. waiting for delayed passengers) can break the causal chain and defeat the Art. 5(3) extraordinary-circumstances defence.

EU air passenger-rights reform political agreement (15 Jun 2026): 96h proactive rights information, codified EC list, no-show ban on return flights; compensation thresholds unchanged; NOT yet in force (12 months after OJ publication).
